verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Terraform exposes a plugin SDK for writing custom providers (terraform-docs-29) and machine-readable JSON output for programmatic consumption (terraform-docs-4/8/18/22/34), plus an official MCP server for AI models (terraform-docs-10/23/36/40), but there is no documented official SDK (e.g., CDK for Terraform or a language-native SDK) that AI-native builders could target directly. missing for 10: explicit official SDK documentation (e.g., CDKTF), examples of programmatic/AI-driven SDK usage, independent hands-on confirmation of SDK reliability.
